sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Pinus pinea, the stone pine, is a Mediterranean tree with a broad, umbrella-shaped crown. It can reach about 25 m.

sections.title: Needles and cones
sections.text: The paired needles are about 10–15 cm long. Rounded cones are 8–15 cm long and up to 10 cm wide; they take about three years to mature.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: The large edible seeds are sold as pine nuts. They are substantially larger than the seeds of the two-needle pinyon, P. edulis.
